falsification_conditions.condition: The price breaks above the previous 52-week high by 10% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above key resistance would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal and suggest a bullish trend, contradicting the blowoff pattern assumption.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score decreases below 40 within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A drop in the blowoff score below this threshold would indicate the pattern is no longer forming, directly contradicting the current assessment.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 200-day moving average is broken below by 3% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear breakdown of this key support level would signal a bearish trend, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal and the blowoff pattern hypothesis.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
